nyra-mission-control.display:name: Nyra Mission Control
nyra-mission-control.description: WaveTerm entrypoint for LLxprt HA, Jefe, Zellij, Letta, OpenClaw, and worker telemetry.

blocks.name: Letta Orchestrator
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8283/v1/health || curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8283/health || true; echo; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8284/mcp || true; sleep 8; done

blocks.name: Bridge Health
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8090/health || true; sleep 5; done

nyra-provider-auth.display:name: LLxprt Provider Auth
nyra-provider-auth.description: Interactive OAuth/keyring setup for subscription-backed LLxprt lanes.

blocks.name: Auth Commands
blocks.cmd: printf '%s\n' '/auth codex enable' '/auth anthropic enable' '/auth gemini enable' '/auth qwen enable' '/key save kimi <key>' '/key save openrouter <key>' '/key save nyra-nexus <key-or-placeholder>' '/key save nyra-worker <key-or-placeholder>'; scripts/run-llxprt-code.sh --profile-load nyra-subscription-ha

blocks.name: RTX5090 OpenClaw
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=5 worker-rtx5090.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker logs -f worker-5090-openclaw' || bash

blocks.name: RTX3090Ti OpenClaw
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=5 worker-rtx3090ti.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker logs -f worker-3090-openclaw' || bash

blocks.name: Stack Status
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; make wave-stack-status; sleep 10; done

blocks.name: Nexus
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://orchestrator.trex-fiordland.ts.net:6000/health || true; sleep 5; done
